limitations: Input timing measures incorrect-card pointer input to two animation frames; it does not measure every successful reward animation.
Earlier cold/warm and 500-round resource suites remain bound to their previous runtime; they were not rerun for this increment.
Physical iOS Safari and speaker audition were not performed.
resolvedDiagnostics: Initial reward rendered simultaneously in the overlay and feedback bar; now only one stamp is rendered at a time.
A closing-tutorial race reproduced on the prior runtime was fixed using the current requested modal rather than a stale render.

Random CPU openings can consume the first card, and refill can reuse the same slot. Fresh-start detail/storage checks now use an available card; refill checks verify the actual replacement and reserve count, preserving their original requirements.
An attempted end of a saved manual test game was rejected by automatic review; the game was left intact and a separate empty origin was used for the opening verification.
